title: DeBRief.jl: a Julia client for Brazilian public-security statistics (Sinesp/MJSP)
description:
DeBRief.jl downloads, caches and normalizes the crime and violence statistics published by Brazil's Ministry of Justice and Public Security (MJSP) through the Sinesp platform: the Sinesp-VDE monthly, municipality-level database (2015-present, 28 indicators) and the classic state-level series (2015-2022, nine typologies).

The package provides a single stable long-format schema across years with differing layouts, accent- and case-insensitive filters, disk caching of raw files, and per-100k rates computed from IBGE/SIDRA population estimates. The two sources are never silently merged.

This is an independent open-source client with no official affiliation to, or endorsement from, the MJSP or the Brazilian government.
